```yaml
name: Build Linux System Libs

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/build_linux_systemlibs.yml

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        variant: [basic, hardsubx]
    steps:
      - name: Cancel previous runs
        uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
        with:
          workflow_id: ${{ github.workflow }}
          all_but_latest: true
          ignore_sha: true
          access_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Qt libraries
        uses: tlambert03/setup-qt-libs@19e4ef2d781d81f5f067182e228b54ec90d23b76

      - name: Cache dependencies
        uses: namespacelabs/nscloud-cache-action@v1
        with:
          path: ~/.cache
          cache: true
          fail-on-cache-miss: false
          detect: true
          spacectl-version: 1.0.0
          spacectl-system-binary: true
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake libffmpeg-dev libqt5core5a libqt5gui5 libqt5widgets5

      - name: Configure
        run: |
          ./configure --system-libs ${{ matrix.variant == 'hardsubx' && '--enable-hardsubx' || '' }} --enable-ocr

      - name: Build
        run: make -j$(nproc)

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ccextractor-${{ matrix.variant }}-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            ccextractor
            ccextractor-hardsubx

      - name: Verify dynamic linking
        run: |
          echo "Basic binary ldd:"
          ldd ccextractor || true
          echo "Hardsubx binary ldd:"
          if [ -f ccextractor-hardsubx ]; then ldd ccextractor-hardsubx; fi
```
